newsitem.title: USA: AIG to expand personal auto direct sales.
newsitem.headline: AIG to expand personal auto direct sales.

text.p: American International Group Inc said on Thursday it was testing new marketing programs to expand its participation in the direct marketing of private passenger auto insurance.
Just last week, AIG said it had entered into an agreement with Auto-By-Tel Corp to market personal auto insurance through its Website on the Internet.
Consumers who visit the Auto-By-Tel Website to purchase a new car or truck can request a quote for automobile insurance from AIG through a dedicated toll-free 800 number.
Quote requests will be processed by AIG customer service representatives, who will provide qualified applicants with a quotation.
AIG markets personal auto insurance directly to consumers through its Domestic Personal Lines business.
Net premiums written in the Domestic Personal Lines business rose 41 percent in 1995 to $692.7 million and operating income nearly doubled to $34.5 million.
AIG had net income of $2.51 billion in 1995.ANY

In Japan, AIG said its American Home subsidiary received Ministry of Finance approval during the quarter of a direct marketing rider for its existing auto insurance products.
United Guaranty Corp, AIG's mortgage guaranty insurance subsidiary, reported a 20.3 percent increase in net premiums written and a 22.8 percent gain in operating income to $41.2 million.
AIG said it added $147 million to its general insurance net loss and loss adjustment reserves in the quarter, bringing the total of those reserves to $20.2 billion at September 30.
